adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, the diff adds `teamDestinationCalendars: DestinationCalendar[]` and, for collective team events, pushes each additional host’s `user.destinationCalendar` into it (inside `teamMemberPromises`). Then it appends them into `evt.destinationCalendar` via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. Since `DestinationCalendar` objects include identifiers like `externalId`/`credentialId`/`userId` (per the finding) and `destinationCalendar` is part of the `CalendarEvent` type that is used across the system (and webhooks/tests in this diff show `destinationCalendar` is serialized in webhook payloads, e.g. `webhook.e2e.ts` changing `null` to `[]`), this change can expose other hosts’ calendar identifiers to downstream consumers that receive the event payload.
